1.9.1 beta 6:
- UNDO is per person: your UNDO shows only your own changes and takes back your latest one, even after others changed things (theirs stay). An Admin's UNDO shows a list to pick any change from.
- SKIP ONE ROTATION on every Take off pop-up: she sits out her next turn and goes back on by herself in her same spot for the next rotation.
- Fix: undoing a NEXT no longer puts in a girl who was waiting to join at the next rotation.
- Also in 1.9.1: past nights' house fees (History tab), iCloud Drive backup, + TIME as another champagne sale, FIX SONG and AUTO NEXT, NOT READY (time in and ready), joining at the next rotation, Combo payment, time in on house fees, PAID / UNPAID asks first.
